title: TRG Latin America Acquisitions Corp. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-13
summary: TRG Latin America Acquisitions Corp., a SPAC incorporated in the Cayman Islands and listed on Nasdaq (tickers: TRGSU, TRGS, TRGSR), filed an 8-K on April 13, 2026 announcing that starting April 20, 2026, holders of its units may elect to separately trade the Class A ordinary shares and Share Rights that comprise the units.
key_points: TRG Latin America Acquisitions Corp. is a SPAC incorporated in the Cayman Islands with ticker symbols TRGSU (units), TRGS (Class A shares), and TRGSR (rights) on Nasdaq
Effective April 20, 2026, unit holders may separately trade Class A ordinary shares and Share Rights
Unseparated units will continue to trade under TRGSU on Nasdaq Global Market
Separated shares expected to trade under TRGS; separated rights expected to trade under TRGSR
Holders must contact Continental Stock Transfer & Trust Company (transfer agent) through their brokers to separate units
Each unit consists of one Class A ordinary share (par value $0.0001) and one right to receive 1/10 of one Class A ordinary share upon business combination
